scientific_limitations: One-dimensional stationary Brownian diffusion with independent rate-r Poisson contractions by a deterministic c in (-1,1), fixed D,r>0, and weak-contraction limit |c| to one. No uniform rare-event prefactors, path-space large deviations, or non-Poisson/general random contractions are proved. Generic tools and exact stationary products are prior work.
title: Dilogarithmic rare-displacement law for weak proportional resetting
